subject: Clarification regarding project ideas and status: GSoC 2017

messages.author: c437a75dc2c46904
messages.subject: Clarification regarding project ideas and status: GSoC 2017
parts:
Hello,

I'm interested to work on the r-caffe project in GSoC'17. But in the project idea github page "need mentors" is mentioned in status. Where as, in other projects where the mentor names are assigned, "need students" is mentioned. Just to clarify, does this mean that in the first project, students can not apply or, students' list has already been exhausted?

Thanks!

messages.author: 50d9fd636762e392
messages.subject: Re: Clarification regarding project ideas and status: GSoC 2017
parts:
It's probably best to take these messages at face value.

"Need mentors" or "need students" means just that, and does not
necessarily imply anything else. Also if you have useful ideas and
energy, it makes sense for a project to try to find a way to bring you
into to team.

My 2 cents.

JN
